elements.requirement: Where a company is being wound up by the court, the liquidator may exercise any of the powers specified in Parts 1 to 3 of Schedule 4.
elements.quote: Where a company is being wound up by the court, the liquidator may exercise any of the powers specified in Parts 1 to 3 of Schedule 4.

elements.requirement: A liquidator who is not the official receiver must give notice to the liquidation committee, if one exists for the time being, if the liquidator exercises statutory powers to dispose of any property of the company to a person connected with the company within the meaning of section 249 in Part VII.
elements.quote: disposes of any property of the company to a person who is connected with the company (within the meaning of section 249 in Part VII)

elements.requirement: A liquidator who is not the official receiver must give notice to the liquidation committee, if one exists for the time being, if the liquidator exercises statutory powers to employ a solicitor to assist in carrying out their functions.
elements.quote: employs a solicitor to assist him in the carrying out of his functions, he shall, if there is for the time being a liquidation committee, give notice to the committee of that exercise of his powers.

elements.requirement: The exercise of statutory powers under section 167 by a liquidator in a winding up by the court is subject to the control of the court.
elements.quote: The exercise by the liquidator in a winding up by the court of the powers conferred by this section is subject to the control of the court

elements.requirement: Any creditor or contributory may apply to the court regarding any exercise or proposed exercise by the liquidator of any powers conferred by section 167.
elements.quote: any creditor or contributory may apply to the court with respect to any exercise or proposed exercise of any of those powers.
